newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani minister resigns to contest election.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani minister resigns to contest election.

text.p: A minister in Pakistan's caretaker government resigned to contest a general election set for February 3, newspapers reported on Tuesday.
Education, Science and Technology, and Tourism Minister Syeda Abida Hussain, defeated in the last two general elections, will stand in the Jhang constituency in Punjab province.
Abida joined the caretaker cabinet after President Farooq Leghari dismissed Benazir Bhutto's government and dissolved the National Assembly (lower house) on November 5.
Caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid has asked members of his cabinet not to stand in the polls.
